name: Sangria
description: A glamorous aunt in her mid sixties, a woman who arrives at every backyard party dressed for a yacht and sings sultry cumbia and Latin pop.
build: A full, curvy adult build of ordinary height: rounded shoulders, full bust and hips, a defined waist, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Warm olive-brown skin, dark brown eyes under arched dark brows, a straight nose, high cheekbones, full lips in deep coral lipstick, and a gold-brown complexion with soft laugh lines.
hair: A big voluminous shoulder-length blow-out of dark auburn hair, full and rounded, swept back from the face.
outfit: Huge round black sunglasses with thick glossy black frames and solid black lenses worn over the eyes; large chunky gold hoop earrings; a knee-length kaftan dress of opaque turquoise silk printed with big bold orange hibiscus blooms, a deep V neck, wide elbow-length sleeves, cinched at the waist with a wide gold sash, the hem ending at the knee; stacked chunky gold bangles on both wrists; gold flat sandals. Both forearms and hands are bare.
performance_style: Hip cocked: feet together, weight on the character-left leg, hip pushed out. The character-right hand rests open on the hip, fingers spread; the character-left hand is raised open beside the shoulder, palm up, fingers visible. Head tilted, a knowing smile.
location: A sunny backyard patio: terracotta pavers running to the bottom of the frame, a white wrought-iron table with a big glass pitcher of red sangria and sliced oranges, potted bougainvillea against a stucco wall behind, and paper lanterns in orange and turquoise strung overhead.
recognition_cues: a turquoise kaftan dress with big orange hibiscus blooms
a big auburn blow-out and chunky gold hoops
palette: sash, hoops, bangles and sandals gold #D4A93A / #8F6F1F / #F5D77A

sing.intent: Cumbia vocal loop: step side to side on a lazy cumbia beat with the hips rolling, the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, the character-left hand waving slowly overhead, then return to the hip-cocked stance. The mouth visibly opens and changes shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief shock at a splash from the kiddie pool: shoulders lift, both open hands fly up by the face, then she smooths back into the hip-cocked stance. No contact or opponent.
animations.guard: One-shot: turn a shoulder forward and raise the character-left open hand, palm out, like refusing gossip, then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: sashay in with swinging hips, stop square to the front, and settle into the hip-cocked stance.
animations.victory: One-shot: throw both open hands high overhead, bangles sliding, head back in a big open laugh, then hold a glamorous pose.
animations.ko: The glamour deflates: shoulders droop, both open hands hang at her sides, the head drops and the hip straightens. She holds a standing, visibly deflated finish, on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
